name: Skills Manager
description: Dynamic skill loading and command contributions for agents

configSchema.description: Whether the skills system is enabled for this agent.
Skill names to always load automatically for this agent.
Skill names that are explicitly denied and never loaded.
Skill names explicitly allowed. When null, all skills are allowed.
Maximum number of skills that can be loaded simultaneously.
Maximum total characters of skill content included in the prompt.
Allow the agent to create and edit skills via the skill_manage tool.
Allow the agent to delete skills and remove supporting files. Requires allowSkillCreation.
Allow the agent to manage SHARED (all-agent) skills under the global skills directory. Opt-in: a change there is visible to every agent.
Allow the agent to record a completed run as a skill via skill_record, through the propose-and-confirm cycle. Requires allowSkillCreation, since recording ends in a skill being written.
